#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())

# Criterios de diseño de estructuras {#sec-structures}

## Resumen ejecutivo {#sec-str_summary}

{{< include /_chapters/structures.summary.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/structures.results.es.qmd",
    stem = "structures-summary",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-structures-summary-site",
    context = "resumen de criterios de estructuras"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

## Resultados {#sec-mcer_results}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_summary/structures.results.es.qmd",
    stem = "structures-results",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    heading = SiteTable$label[[i]],
    level = 3L,
    anchor = "sec-structures-results-site",
    context = "resultados de criterios de estructuras"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/MCER.ES.qmd",
    stem = "structures-mcer",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "figura de criterios de estructuras"
  )
}
rm(i, SiteTable)
```
